description:

 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a skilled PLC Industrial Automation Support Consultant to support commissioning, operational stabilization, and troubleshooting of industrial automation systems integrated with WMS/WCS environments. The candidate should have strong experience in PLC systems, OPC communications, industrial automation, and warehouse automation integrations. 
 
 Roles Responsibilities 
 Provide commissioning and operational support for PLC systems and automation infrastructure. Support OPC communication and integration activities between automation equipment and WMS/WCS platforms. Troubleshoot automation, control system, and integration issues through log analysis and diagnostics. Validate PLC-WCS/WMS interface behavior and system performance. Coordinate with automation vendors and technology partners for defect resolution and enhancements. Support testing, system validation, and operational stabilization activities. Document technical issues, resolutions, and operational procedures. Coordinate with WMS/WCS teams to troubleshoot end-to-end integration issues. 
 
 Required Skills (Mandatory) 
 Strong knowledge of PLC systems and industrial automation. Experience with OPC communication protocols. Understanding of WCS and WMS integrations. Experience in automation commissioning and support projects. Ability to analyze logs, diagnose issues, and identify root causes. Understanding of industrial communication protocols and control systems. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Good communication and customer-facing abilities. Willingness to work onsite at customer locations. 
 
 Preferred Skills Experience 
 Experience in warehouse automation, ASRS, AGVs, conveyors. Experience working in manufacturing, logistics, or automated warehouse environments. Experience working with multi-vendor automation environments.

title: WMS / WCS Automation Support Consultant
description:
Job Summary We are seeking an experienced WMS/WCS Automation Support Consultant to support warehouse automation commissioning, operational stabilization, and production support activities at a customer site. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Warehouse Control Systems (WCS), automation integrations, and operational troubleshooting. Roles Responsibilities Provide commissioning and operational support for WMS and WCS applications. Understand, analyze, and validate warehouse business processes and automation workflows. Troubleshoot application and system issues through log analysis and root cause investigation. Validate implemented solutions against business and operational requirements. Coordinate with WMS/WCS development and vendor teams for defect resolution and enhancements. Work closely with customer project teams, operations teams, and other stakeholders. Support operational stabilization during commissioning and go-live phases. Monitor system performance and recommend improvements for operational efficiency. Assist with issue tracking, documentation, and reporting activities. Coordinate with automation/PLC teams for WMS-WCS-automation integration-related issues. Required Skills (Mandatory) Strong knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). Good understanding of Warehouse Control Systems (WCS). Experience in warehouse automation and system integrations. Hands-on experience in troubleshooting application and system issues. Ability to analyze logs and identify root causes. Familiarity with commissioning and stabilization activities. Basic understanding of PLC-based automation systems. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Willingness to work onsite at customer locations. Preferred Skills Experience Experience with SAP EWM or similar WMS platforms. Exposure to ASRS, Shuttle System, AGV, conveyor systems, and warehouse automation technologies.
